This is not a company, we are a voluntary PRO LIFE non-profitmaking organisation. C.A.A.R.S is operated by its volunteer members and supported by charitable means. C.A.A.R.S is registered with the Charity Commision, registration No.1147495 this allows us to further our rescue efforts to extended areas of the country.

 We are a voluntary organisation, a Registered Charity, relying solely upon the goodwill of the general public. Unlike the majority of our counterparts, we receive no funding whatsoever over and above the donations we receive from public support. We try to recover around 60% of our outlay in rescuing the animals, from the donations recommended by CAARS committee.
